tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dam chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa la bsngags pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dam pa'i chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi ba gdong bzhi mig stong ldan pa dang*// dpal mo'i dpal dang klu dbang stobs ldan sogs// 'jig rten mchod 'os rnams kyis gus mchod pa'i// thub dbang zhabs kyi pad+mor rtag tu 'dud// des gsungs dri med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i gsung*// gsung rab rmad byung zhi lam 'jug pa'i sgo// sgo gsum gus pas brten na bde dang legs// legs rtsol dam pa'i chos la mgos phyag 'tshal// tshul khrims me tog legs spyad mdangs bkra zhing*// dge legs ze'u 'bru snyan pa'i dri bsrung ldang*// rtog pa'i snying po gzhan phan sbrang rtsi can// dge 'dun pad+mo rgyas pa rgyas gyur cig /legs spyad gser gyi sa gzhi las 'khrungs shing*// brtse ba'i lhun mdzes phan bde'i lo 'dab can// rnam grol 'bras ldan bsdu ba'i bsil grib kyis// nyon mongs gdung sel dpal ldan bla mas skyongs// gang zhig chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rnam dag spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*// zung 'jug 'od gsal thabs tshul mchog brnyes nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'od gzhan zil mnan nas// sna tshogs skar ma'i tshogs ltar rab bkra bkra ba'i mdangs ldan du ma'i skur bstan te// gdul bya 'dul mdzad 'dul ba'i thabs la mnga' brnyes skyed mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal lo// de sras rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing*// bsam yas bkod pa 'byam klas pas// 'di ni mi mjed 'jig rten te// sprul pa'i sku yi zhing zhes bgyi// gang tshe bskal bzang dus 'di la// rnam 'dren brgya phrag bcu dang ni// gnyis kyis lhag pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rim gyis 'byon 'gyur de yang ni// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub dang*// 'od srungs bde bar gshegs pa'i rjes// skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe// shākya'i rgyal po nye bar byon// de yi bstan pa lnga stong du// gnas par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa las// sngon chad lo grangs sum stong dang*// bcu yis lhag pa'i bzhi brgya song*// stong dang lnga brgya dgu bcu snyed// slad nas gnas 'gyur lnga brgya phrag

/bdun pa mngon pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs char// rang dpal rnam par 'byor gyur pas// gzhan dpal kun nas 'phrog byed cing*// dpal gyi dpal yang 'phel byed pa// jing gir gan zhes bya ba byung*// de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa'i tshe// go pe la rgyal rgyal ba'i sras// chos rgyal mi dbang sa skyong zhing*// dad dang mkhyen rab chen po yis// bstan par zhugs shing bstan pa skyong*// bstan pa mchog gi brtul zhugs kyis// rnam par brgyan pa de yi sras// rgyal sras jim gyim zhes grags pa// rig gzugs ngang tshul bzang ldan zhing*// dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa can// brtul zhugs mchog gis rnam par mdzes// dad dang shes rab phul du byung*// yab mes las 'ongs 'jig rten gyi// lugs kyis 'jig rten legs skyong zhing*// 'chi med chos kyi gtsug lag gi /bstan pa rin chen gsal bar mdzad// 'di yi mdzad pa gang de chos bzhin mdzad pas chos kyi dbang sgyur thub pa'i dbang pos kyang*// bsngags par 'os na bram ze'i rje dang gtsug na zla ba 'jug sred dpal dang dbang po sogs// chen por yongs grags mthu stobs cher ldan de dag gis ni nyin re zhing yang phyogs rnams su// bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrogs bgyid smos ci 'tshal te bsngags 'os khyod dpal rgyas bgyid grang*// 'di yi yab mes sogs kyi bka' drin la// byas pa mkhyen nas lan du blan phyir dang*// nyid kyis bla med go 'phang brnyes bya'i phyir// sngon yang dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// zab mo ston pa shes rab pha rol phyin// rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gser bzang 'bar bas bzhengs// slar yang rgya chen ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// phal che'i dgongs pa 'khor 'das phal cher gyi// rnam par dgod pa ston pa phal po che// shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod zhes kyang bya// pad+ma'i rgyan dang mdo sde rmad ga cad// ces sogs grags pa'ang gser gyis bzhengs dgongs nas/

yo byad bcas te bzhengs zhes bka' lung ni// de yi dge ba'i bshes gyur gang de la// nye bar springs nas des kyang de nyid kyi// slob ma dge slong shes rab rin chen la// legs par bsgos nas dpal ldan sa skya'i shar// rgyal sras thu bo spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /zhing gyur zhwa lu zhes bya me glang gi /dbyar zla 'bring la yi ge'i 'du byed la// shin tu sbyangs pa bsod nams skyabs la sogs// brgya phrag lhag dang rkos gser dras sogs kyi// las la rab mkhas bzo sbyangs mang bsogs nas// rgyal bas spros pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin du// dam chos rin chen 'di ni lhun gyis grub// 'di ni rgyal bu'i phyag byar 'os pa ste// de nyid srid zhi'i che bar rab grags pa// kun gyis kyang ni brjod par 'os pa lags// de 'dra bzhengs nas rab tu gnas pa'ang bgyis// ji ltar 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig gis// rnam par spras pa'i nyi ma shar phyogs nas// nub tu shar bas de gsal bgyid pa ltar// chos 'di dpal gyi gzi yis rab lham pa// nub nas shar du shar ba'i shar phyogs nas// brtsams te zhing kun gsal bar gyis lags grang*// de ltar dgongs nas mchod la nan tan mdzod// de yi dge bas rgyal sras jim gyim dang*// yab yum brgyud par bcas dang de bzhin du// btsun mo go go can ni sras dang bcas// mched zlar bcas rnams sku tshe ring ba dang*// dpal 'byor phun tshogs bstan dang 'gro ba yi// dpal du gyur nas chos tshul kun spyad de// mkha' mnyam sems can kun dang thabs cig tu// sa dang lam kun bgrod nas srid zhi'i dpal// rgyal ba'i dbang po'i go 'phang thob par shog /de lta'i rnam thar rmad byung ba// snyan ngag snyan pas bsdebs pa 'di// me glang bre yi nyer lnga la// dpal ldan sa skyar bris pa dge /phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
